news.title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
news.summary: The Federal Reserve released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting on Wednesday. The minutes were released to coincide with the release of the minutes of the Fed's September meeting.

news.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
news.summary: Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers. The cost of shipping has soared as a result of the war.

news.title: 10-year Treasury yield backs off from 24-year high after solid bond auction eases demand fears
news.summary: U.S. Treasury yields came off their highs after a solid sale of 10-year notes. U.S., German bond yields also came off highs after solid sale.

news.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
news.summary: Microsoft continues to make its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers. The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PC. The Microsoft Surface Pro 2 is expected to be released later this year.

news.title: Here comes third-quarter earnings season. Booming profits could propel the S&P 500 to new heights
news.summary: Third-quarter earnings season kicks off this week. The market is eagerly anticipating what the market is anticipating: blockbuster profits. The Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 0.3% this morning.

news.title: Stocks are increasingly their own best hedge. This chart shows why.
news.summary: For decades, investors concerned about stocks sought succor in the bond market. But these days, the best shield against an outbreak of volatility might just be owning other stocks.

news.title: Fed’s minutes show no appetite for a series of interest-rate hikes
news.summary: September’s rate hike was viewed by many officials as needed just in case inflation remains sticky. “We’re not going to let inflation get out of control,” said a top Fed official.

news.title: SpaceX may chase ‘stunning’ AI returns by taking on a lot of debt to buy Nvidia chips
news.summary: A report says SpaceX is considering raising $40 billion to finance the purchase of advanced graphic processing units and related systems. The company is expected to launch its first rocket in 2018.

news.title: ‘He grew up wealthy’: My husband inherited $3 million. He wants a vacation home. I want to save for retirement. Who’s right?
news.summary: “I keep thinking about giving each child $750,000 toward a house,” he says. “I’m going to give each child a house.”

news.title: Washington and Wall Street chose to delay paying their bills — and to put them on your tab
news.summary: The polite word for what the government and Wall Street are doing is deferring payment. It's like opening a tab at a bar that somebody else will pay later.
